name: ima2-gen
description: Local-first visual generation runtime and studio for people and coding agents, with reproducible image and video workflows across multiple providers.

paragraphs: Generate, branch and clean up images and video on your own machine.
One local studio for GPT, Grok, Gemini, NovelAI and ComfyUI.
Use it from the browser, the Mac app, the CLI, or hand it to your coding agent.
features: Create: generate, edit, reuse the current image, paste references, and continue from history. Attach up to 5 references for images or up to 14 for video; large images are compressed before upload. Turn on multimode to…

Node graph: branch a good image into several directions. Root nodes take local references; child nodes use their parent image as the source. Finished jobs are matched back by request ID, so reloads and graph version…

Canvas Mode: zoom, pan, annotate with hover highlighting, erase, group, undo, add sticky notes, clean backgrounds and export with preserved alpha or a matte color. Choose SVG (embedded raster) for a self-contained…

Video: text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video through Grok video models, with live progress and First/Mid/Last frame copy buttons; SSE progress shows planning → submitted → progress % → done. Storyboard…
Raster to vector: trace flat raster art into real SVG paths with ima2 vectorize, from AssetGen/Assets, or from Canvas Export.

whatItDoes.text: Generate, branch and clean up images and video on your own machine.

requirements.text: GPT OAuth — log in with a ChatGPT account (images)
Grok OAuth — log in with an xAI/Grok account (images and video)
provider: "nai" calls the NovelAI image API with a persistent API token (saved in Settings > API Keys or NOVELAIAPIKEY; no fixed token prefix is required).
Set OPENAIAPIKEY or configure an API key before using provider: "api".
